summary: Invoice line items showing unexpected negative credits labeled 'Misc' causing accounting mismatch
description: Issue summary: Datacove reports several invoices for February-March 2026 that contain one or more negative credit line items with the description 'Misc' and a zeroed or mismatched ledger reference. Impact: Accounting cannot reconcile month-end invoices; customer requests explanation and corrective credit where applicable. Environment: hosted billing pipeline (prod), invoices generated by billing-service v3.2.1. Steps to reproduce: 1) Customer views invoice ID INV-2026-DA-1398 via Console > Billing. 2) Under line items, observe a negative credit of -$1,200 labeled 'Misc' with no linked usage record. 3) Check billing logs for invoice generation time window (2026-03-01 02:00 UTC). Investigation notes: Initial support triage found an automatic credit job that aggregates manual adjustments and promotion credits. There is a hypothesis that a failed retry on the adjustment aggregation job double-applied a reversal in rare cases when an external webhook returned 500 and then later a delayed success retried. We have not reproduced on staging. Next steps: capture full billing-service logs for invoice generation window, confirm whether manual finance adjustments were submitted by Datacove, and if confirmed, produce corrected invoice and audit trail.
